notes.title: Multiplayer mode in upcoming update AimGod 3.0
notes.content:
We are currently working on a multiplayer mode where you can compete against your opponent in your chosen mode.

Statistics of both players will be shown and compared after the end of each round.

This way, you can easily compare yourself to other players from around the world or just your friends. It's up to you who you choose to compete against.

This feature is a key to improving aim even more and even faster.

AimGod 3.0 update with the available multiplayer mode is coming soon.

notes.title: Aim God 2.0 - 5 New modes, 94 Achievements & Controller Support
notes.content:
[b]🔫 New modes[/b]
We are introducing a bunch of modes that will help you practice your aim and increase your accuracy in any FPS games.
[list]
[*] Grid - Practice little mouse movement on a 3x3 grid 
[*] Track - Track & Spray spheres jumping around the map
[*] Motion - Practice your movement from static to moving sphere
[*] React - How fast can you react once a sphere spawns?
[*] Peek - Hit peeking spheres from behind cubes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416874/7c1e9022164fbaa9f45cceb7f6bdedf24ecc2a6b.png[/img]

[b]🎖 Achievements[/b]
As you play, you can reach multiple milestones in Aim God. In each mode, you can complete up to 10 achievements! Nine for the number of games you finish and one extra for ZERO misses! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416874/b76efbc974ee06a6cc8b18bb908bb19890701d03.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Controller Support[/b]
And last, but not least - we are adding support for controllers! Aim God is the aim trainer you can get if you prefer a controller when playing an fps game.
